commit_message: feat(boundaries): add 2002 general and Maori electorate boundaries and Stats NZ datafinder capture receipts
publish_method: Hugging Face create_commit (regular inline commit; no Xet forcing needed)
cas_dedupe_note: the two capture receipts list 28 objects, but layer and version metadata are byte-identical within a layer, so 16 distinct objects cover the 2 new boundary bundles plus all 20 attribute/metadata entries

verification.method: downloaded each committed path from the Hub and compared sha256 with the local pre-commit digest

deliberately_not_published.reason: verification-only re-captures; the archive already holds these layers' bytes from the ArcGIS FeatureServer pipeline, so republishing would duplicate them and blur which capture is canonical
